mapper.sql: id, type_id AS typeId, value, label_zh AS labelZh, label_en AS labelEn, label_vi AS labelVi, sort_order AS sortOrder, enabled, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dict_item WHERE type_id = #{typeId} ORDER BY sort_order, id LIMIT 1001
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_item(type_id, value, label_zh, label_en, label_vi, sort_order, enabled) VALUES (#{entity.typeId}, #{entity.value}, #{entity.labelZh}, #{entity.labelEn}, #{entity.labelVi}, #{entity.sortOrder}, #{entity.enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_item SET type_id = #{entity.typeId}, value = #{entity.value}, label_zh = #{entity.labelZh}, label_en = #{entity.labelEn}, label_vi = #{entity.labelVi}, sort_order = #{entity.sortOrder}, enabled = #{entity.enabled}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{entity.id} AND version = #{entity.version}
